name: @0xwh1sker/mantle-mcp

tools.name: mantle_getChainInfo
tools.description: Return static chain configuration for mainnet or sepolia (Mantle native gas token is MNT). Examples: mainnet chain_id=5000 with WMNT=0x78c1b0C915c4FAA5FffA6CAbf0219DA63d7f4cb8; sepolia chain_id=5003 with WMNT=0x19f5557E23e9914A18239990f6C70D68FDF0deD5.

tools.name: mantle_getChainStatus
tools.description: Return live block height and gas price from Mantle RPC. Examples: mainnet block_number=12345678 and gas_price_gwei="0.02"; sepolia health check before running token workflows.

tools.name: mantle_resolveAddress
tools.description: Resolve trusted contract addresses by key, alias, or label from the Mantle registry. Examples: identifier='USDC' -> 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9; identifier='Agni Router' -> 0x319B69888b0d11cEC22caA5034e25FfFBDc88421.

environment.description: Legacy alias for network (`testnet` maps to `sepolia`).

tools.name: mantle_validateAddress
tools.description: Validate address format/checksum and optional bytecode presence. Examples: 0x78c1b0C915c4FAA5FffA6CAbf0219DA63d7f4cb8 (WMNT) and 0x319B69888b0d11cEC22caA5034e25FfFBDc88421 (Agni Router).

tools.name: mantle_getBalance
tools.description: Get native MNT balance for an address. Examples: address=0x458F293454fE0d67EC0655f3672301301DD51422 -> balance_mnt='1.5' before contract operations.

tools.name: mantle_getTokenBalances
tools.description: Batch read ERC-20 token balances for an address. Examples: tokens=['USDC','WETH'] -> 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9 and 0xdEAddEaDdeadDEadDEADDEAddEADDEAddead1111.

tools.name: mantle_getAllowances
tools.description: Batch read ERC-20 allowances for token/spender pairs. Examples: pair {token:'USDC', spender:'0x319B69888b0d11cEC22caA5034e25FfFBDc88421'} for Agni Router.

tools.name: mantle_getTokenInfo
tools.description: Read ERC-20 token metadata (name, symbol, decimals, total supply). Examples: token='USDC' -> 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9, token='WETH' -> 0xdEAddEaDdeadDEadDEADDEAddEADDEAddead1111.

tools.name: mantle_getTokenPrices
tools.description: Read token prices for valuation workflows; returns null when no trusted source exists. Examples: tokens=['USDC','WMNT'] on mainnet (0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9, 0x78c1b0C915c4FAA5FffA6CAbf0219DA63d7f4cb8).

tools.name: mantle_resolveToken
tools.description: Resolve token symbol using quick reference plus canonical token-list cross-check. Examples: symbol='USDC' -> 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9, symbol='mETH' -> 0xcDA86A272531e8640cD7F1a92c01839911B90bb0.

tools.name: mantle_getSwapQuote
tools.description: Read swap quotes for Agni and Merchant Moe routes. Examples: WMNT 0x78c1b0C915c4FAA5FffA6CAbf0219DA63d7f4cb8 to USDC 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9 via Agni router 0x319B69888b0d11cEC22caA5034e25FfFBDc88421.

tools.name: mantle_getPoolLiquidity
tools.description: Read pool reserves and liquidity metadata. Examples: inspect a Mantle DEX pool for USDC 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9 / USDT0 0x779Ded0c9e1022225f8E0630b35a9b54bE713736 liquidity.

tools.name: mantle_getPoolOpportunities
tools.description: Scan and rank candidate pools for a token pair on Mantle DEXes. Examples: token_a='MNT' (native mapped to WMNT 0x78c1b0C915c4FAA5FffA6CAbf0219DA63d7f4cb8), token_b='mETH' 0xcDA86A272531e8640cD7F1a92c01839911B90bb0.

tools.name: mantle_getProtocolTvl
tools.description: Read protocol-level TVL for Mantle DeFi protocols using layered sources. Examples: protocol=agni for Agni Finance TVL, protocol=merchant_moe for Merchant Moe TVL, protocol=all for combined view.

tools.name: mantle_getLendingMarkets
tools.description:
Read Aave V3 lending market metrics on Mantle, including Isolation Mode data.

Each market includes: supply/borrow APY, TVL, LTV, liquidation threshold, isolation_mode (bool), debt_ceiling_usd, borrowable_in_isolation (bool), borrowing_enabled.

Isolation Mode assets (WETH, WMNT): supplying them as your ONLY collateral restricts borrows to assets with borrowable_in_isolation=true (USDC, USDT0, USDe, GHO).

Examples:
- All markets: protocol='aave_v3'
- Single market: protocol='aave_v3', asset='USDC'

tools.name: mantle_getV3PoolState
tools.description:
Read on-chain state of a Uniswap V3-compatible pool (Agni Finance or Fluxion) on Mantle. Returns sqrtPriceX96, current tick, tick spacing, liquidity, and human-readable prices.

Resolve by pool_address directly, or by (token_a + token_b + fee_tier + provider) to look up via the factory.

Examples:
- By address: pool_address='<pool_address>'
- By pair: token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', fee_tier=3000, provider='agni'

pool_address.description: V3 pool contract address. If provided, token_a/token_b/fee_tier/provider are optional.

token_a.description: First token symbol or address. Required if pool_address is not given.

token_b.description: Second token symbol or address. Required if pool_address is not given.

fee_tier.description: V3 fee tier in hundredths of a bip (500=0.05%, 3000=0.3%, 10000=1%). Required if pool_address is not given.

provider.description: DEX provider: 'agni' or 'fluxion'. Required if pool_address is not given; optional hint when pool_address is given.

tools.name: mantle_getLBPairState
tools.description:
Read on-chain state of a Merchant Moe Liquidity Book pair on Mantle. Returns active bin ID, bin step, token metadata, active bin reserves, and reserves for +-5 nearby bins.

Resolve by pair_address directly, or by (token_a + token_b + bin_step) to look up via the LB Factory.

Examples:
- By address: pair_address='<pair_address>'
- By pair: token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', bin_step=25

pair_address.description: LB pair contract address. If provided, token_a/token_b/bin_step are optional.

token_a.description: First token symbol or address. Required if pair_address is not given.

token_b.description: Second token symbol or address. Required if pair_address is not given.

bin_step.description: LB bin step (e.g. 1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25). Required if pair_address is not given.

tools.name: mantle_getV3Positions
tools.description:
Enumerate all V3 LP positions for a wallet across Agni Finance and Fluxion on Mantle. Returns token IDs, tick ranges, liquidity, uncollected fees, and whether each position is in-range.

By default filters out zero-liquidity, zero-fees positions (set include_empty=true to show all).

Examples:
- All positions: owner='<wallet_address>'
- Agni only: owner='<wallet_address>', provider='agni'
- Include empty: owner='<wallet_address>', include_empty=true

owner.description: Wallet address to enumerate LP positions for.

provider.description: Optional filter: 'agni' or 'fluxion'. Omit to scan both.

include_empty.description: Include zero-liquidity and zero-fees positions (default: false).

tools.name: mantle_suggestTickRange
tools.description:
Suggest tick ranges for a V3 LP position on Mantle (Agni or Fluxion). Reads current pool state and generates three strategies (wide/moderate/tight) with tick bounds snapped to the pool's tick spacing grid and corresponding prices.

Accepts the same inputs as mantle_getV3PoolState: pool_address OR (token_a + token_b + fee_tier + provider).

Examples:
- By address: pool_address='<pool_address>'
- By pair: token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', fee_tier=3000, provider='agni'

pool_address.description: V3 pool contract address. If provided, token_a/token_b/fee_tier/provider are optional.

token_a.description: First token symbol or address. Required if pool_address is not given.

token_b.description: Second token symbol or address. Required if pool_address is not given.

fee_tier.description: V3 fee tier (500, 3000, 10000). Required if pool_address is not given.

provider.description: DEX provider: 'agni' or 'fluxion'. Required if pool_address is not given.

tools.name: mantle_analyzePool
tools.description:
[ANALYZE] Deep analysis of a V3 pool on Mantle (Agni or Fluxion). Returns:
- Fee APR based on 24h volume / TVL
- Multi-range APR comparison (10 brackets from ±1% to ±50%)
- Risk assessment (TVL risk, volatility risk, concentration risk)
- Investment return projections (daily/weekly/monthly fees for a given USD amount)
- Recommended range based on recent volatility

Accepts the same inputs as mantle_getV3PoolState: pool_address OR (token_a + token_b + fee_tier + provider).
Optionally pass investment_usd (default: 1000) to see projected returns.

Examples:
- Analyze WMNT/USDC on Agni: token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', fee_tier=3000, provider='agni'
- With investment amount: pool_address='<pool_address>', investment_usd=5000

pool_address.description: V3 pool contract address. If provided, token_a/token_b/fee_tier/provider are optional.

token_a.description: First token symbol or address. Required if pool_address is not given.

token_b.description: Second token symbol or address. Required if pool_address is not given.

fee_tier.description: V3 fee tier (500, 3000, 10000). Required if pool_address is not given.

provider.description: DEX provider: 'agni' or 'fluxion'. Required if pool_address is not given.

investment_usd.description: USD amount to project returns for (default: 1000). Used to calculate daily/weekly/monthly fee income.

tools.name: mantle_findPools
tools.description:
Discover all available liquidity pools for a token pair across ALL Mantle DEXes (Agni, Fluxion, Merchant Moe) by querying factory contracts on-chain. Returns every pool with its fee tier/bin step and whether it has liquidity.

This is the authoritative pool discovery tool — it queries factory contracts directly, not external indexers. Use it BEFORE adding LP to find the best pool.

Scans:
- Agni & Fluxion: fee tiers 100 (0.01%), 500 (0.05%), 3000 (0.3%), 10000 (1%)
- Merchant Moe: bin steps 1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25

Examples:
- Find USDC/USDe pools: token_a='USDC', token_b='USDe'
- Find WMNT/USDC pools: token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC'

tools.name: mantle_getLBPositions
tools.description:
Scan a wallet's Merchant Moe Liquidity Book LP positions on Mantle. Checks all known LB pairs and reads bin balances around the active bin (+-25 bins) to find user-held liquidity.

COVERAGE NOTE: This is a heuristic scan around the current active price, not a full enumeration. Positions minted in bins far from the active price (more than 25 bins away) will not be detected. Coverage is limited to known pairs in the registry.

Returns per-pair breakdown with bin IDs, user share percentage, and estimated token amounts (tokenX/tokenY) based on pro-rata share of bin reserves.

Use this tool for:
- Approximate portfolio valuation of Merchant Moe LB LP positions
- Understanding near-price liquidity distribution
- Pre-removal checks (which nearby bins hold your liquidity)

Examples:
- All LB positions: owner='<wallet_address>'
- Specific network: owner='<wallet_address>', network='mainnet'

owner.description: Wallet address to enumerate LB positions for.

tools.name: mantle_getAavePositions
tools.description:
Read a wallet's Aave V3 positions on Mantle: supplied collateral, borrowed debt (both variable and stable), health factor, liquidation threshold, and per-reserve aToken/debtToken balances.

Returns aggregate account data (total collateral/debt in USD, health factor with status classification) plus per-reserve breakdowns for all reserves with non-zero supply or debt. Reads stableDebtToken addresses dynamically from on-chain data.

Uses multicall to batch all balance reads into minimal RPC round-trips.

Use this tool for:
- Portfolio valuation (aToken balances are positive assets, debtTokens are liabilities)
- Liquidation risk assessment (health_factor < 1 = liquidatable)
- Pre-transaction safety checks (available borrows, current LTV)

Examples:
- All positions: user='<wallet_address>'
- Specific network: user='<wallet_address>', network='mainnet'

user.description: Wallet address to query Aave V3 positions for.

tools.name: mantle_buildApprove
tools.description:
Build an unsigned ERC-20 approve transaction. Validates spender is whitelisted. IMPORTANT: Pass 'owner' (the wallet address) to auto-check existing allowance — if already sufficient, returns intent='approve_skip' and you should NOT sign/broadcast.

Examples:
- Approve WMNT for Agni SwapRouter: token='WMNT', spender='0x319B69888b0d11cEC22caA5034e25FfFBDc88421', amount='100', owner='0xYourWallet'
- Unlimited approve USDC for Aave Pool: token='USDC', spender='0x458F293454fE0d67EC0655f3672301301DD51422', amount='max', owner='0xYourWallet'

spender.description: Address of the contract to approve (must be on the whitelist).

amount.description: Decimal amount to approve (e.g. '100'). Use 'max' for unlimited.

owner.description: Wallet address that owns the tokens. Used to check existing allowance and skip if sufficient.

tools.name: mantle_buildWrapMnt
tools.description:
Build an unsigned transaction to wrap MNT into WMNT. Returns calldata with value field set to the wrap amount.

Examples:
- Wrap 10 MNT: amount='10'
- Wrap 0.5 MNT: amount='0.5'

amount.description: Decimal amount of MNT to wrap (e.g. '10').

tools.name: mantle_buildUnwrapMnt
tools.description:
Build an unsigned transaction to unwrap WMNT back to MNT.

Examples:
- Unwrap 10 WMNT: amount='10'
- Unwrap 0.5 WMNT: amount='0.5'

amount.description: Decimal amount of WMNT to unwrap (e.g. '10').

tools.name: mantle_buildSwap
tools.description:
Build an unsigned swap transaction on a whitelisted DEX. Pool parameters (bin_step, fee_tier) are auto-discovered on-chain for the best liquidity pool.

WORKFLOW:
1. Call mantle_getSwapQuote to get expected output, provider, and resolved_pool_params
2. Call mantle_buildApprove for token_in → router (if allowance insufficient)
3. Call mantle_buildSwap with: provider from quote, amount_out_min from quote's minimum_out_raw, and quote_fee_tier/quote_provider from resolved_pool_params for cross-validation
4. Sign and broadcast each unsigned_tx

The response includes pool_params showing the actual fee_tier/bin_step used — compare with your quote's resolved_pool_params to verify consistency.

Examples:
- Swap 100 USDC for USDT0 on Merchant Moe: provider='merchant_moe', token_in='USDC', token_out='USDT0', amount_in='100', recipient='0x...'
- Swap 10 WMNT for USDC on Agni: provider='agni', token_in='WMNT', token_out='USDC', amount_in='10', recipient='0x...'

amount_in.description: Decimal amount of token_in to swap (e.g. '10').

amount_out_min.description: REQUIRED: Minimum output in raw units (from mantle_getSwapQuote minimum_out_raw). Protects against slippage and sandwich attacks.

allow_zero_min.description: Set to true to allow zero amount_out_min (DANGEROUS — no slippage protection). Only use for testing.

fee_tier.description: V3 fee tier (500=0.05%, 3000=0.3%, 10000=1%). Auto-resolved from known pairs for agni/fluxion.

bin_step.description: LB bin step (1=stablecoins, 2=LSTs, 25=volatile). Auto-resolved from known pairs for merchant_moe.

quote_provider.description: Provider from a prior getSwapQuote call. Used to cross-validate consistency — emits a warning if build resolves a different provider.

quote_fee_tier.description: Fee tier from a prior getSwapQuote resolved_pool_params. Used to cross-validate — emits a warning if build resolves a different fee tier.

quote_bin_step.description: Bin step from a prior getSwapQuote resolved_pool_params. Used to cross-validate — emits a warning if build resolves a different bin step.

tools.name: mantle_buildAddLiquidity
tools.description:
Build an unsigned add-liquidity transaction. For V3 DEXes (agni/fluxion) mints an NFT position. For Merchant Moe LB adds to bin-based pools.

Amount modes:
- Token amounts: provide amount_a and amount_b directly
- USD amount: provide amount_usd to auto-split 50/50 between tokens (fetches live prices)

Examples:
- Token mode: provider='agni', token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', amount_a='10', amount_b='8', recipient='0x...'
- USD mode: provider='agni', token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', amount_usd=1000, recipient='0x...'

amount_a.description: Decimal amount of token_a. Required unless amount_usd is provided.

amount_b.description: Decimal amount of token_b. Required unless amount_usd is provided.

amount_usd.description: USD amount to invest (auto-splits 50/50 between tokens using live prices). Alternative to amount_a + amount_b. Example: 1000 for $1000.

tick_lower.description: Lower tick bound. For agni/fluxion. Default: full range.

tick_upper.description: Upper tick bound. For agni/fluxion. Default: full range.

id_slippage.description: Bin ID slippage tolerance. For merchant_moe.

delta_ids.description: Relative bin IDs for distribution. For merchant_moe.

distribution_x.description: Token X distribution per bin (1e18 = 100%). For merchant_moe.

distribution_y.description: Token Y distribution per bin (1e18 = 100%). For merchant_moe.

tools.name: mantle_buildRemoveLiquidity
tools.description:
Build an unsigned remove-liquidity transaction. For V3 DEXes uses decreaseLiquidity+collect via multicall. For Merchant Moe LB removes from specified bins.

V3 amount modes:
- Exact liquidity: provide 'liquidity' as a raw amount
- Percentage: provide 'percentage' (1-100) to remove a portion of the position (reads current liquidity on-chain)

Examples:
- Remove 50% of V3 position: provider='agni', token_id='12345', percentage=50, recipient='0x...'
- Remove all V3 position: provider='agni', token_id='12345', percentage=100, recipient='0x...'
- Remove exact liquidity: provider='agni', token_id='12345', liquidity='1000000', recipient='0x...'
- Remove LB bins on Merchant Moe: provider='merchant_moe', token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', ids=[8388608], amounts=['1000000'], recipient='0x...'

token_id.description: V3 NFT position token ID. For agni/fluxion.

liquidity.description: Exact amount of liquidity to remove. For agni/fluxion. Use 'percentage' for proportional removal.

percentage.description: Percentage of position liquidity to remove (1-100). For agni/fluxion. Reads current liquidity on-chain and calculates the amount. Example: 50 removes half, 100 removes all.

token_a.description: First token symbol or address. For merchant_moe.

token_b.description: Second token symbol or address. For merchant_moe.

ids.description: Bin IDs to remove from. For merchant_moe.

amounts.description: Amounts per bin to remove. For merchant_moe.

tools.name: mantle_buildAaveSupply
tools.description:
Build an unsigned Aave V3 supply (deposit) transaction. Remember to approve the asset for the Pool contract first.

IMPORTANT: Only USDT0 is supported on Aave V3 — NOT USDT. If the user holds USDT, swap USDT → USDT0 on Merchant Moe first.

ISOLATION MODE: WETH and WMNT are Isolation Mode assets. Supplying them as your ONLY collateral restricts borrows to: USDC, USDT0, USDe, GHO. Other assets CANNOT be borrowed in Isolation Mode.

Examples:
- Supply 100 USDC: asset='USDC', amount='100', on_behalf_of='0x...'
- Supply 10 WMNT: asset='WMNT', amount='10', on_behalf_of='0x...'

asset.description: Token symbol or address to supply.

on_behalf_of.description: Address that will receive the aTokens (typically the sender).

tools.name: mantle_buildAaveBorrow
tools.description:
Build an unsigned Aave V3 borrow transaction. Requires sufficient collateral deposited first.

IMPORTANT: Only USDT0 is supported on Aave V3 — NOT USDT. If the user wants to borrow Tether, use asset='USDT0'.

ISOLATION MODE: If the borrower's only collateral is an Isolation Mode asset (WETH, WMNT), they can ONLY borrow assets flagged as borrowableInIsolation: USDC, USDT0, USDe, GHO. Attempting to borrow other assets (sUSDe, FBTC, syrupUSDT, wrsETH, WETH, WMNT) will REVERT.

Examples:
- Borrow 50 USDC at variable rate: asset='USDC', amount='50', on_behalf_of='0x...'
- Borrow 10 WMNT at variable rate: asset='WMNT', amount='10', on_behalf_of='0x...'

asset.description: Token symbol or address to borrow.

on_behalf_of.description: Address of the borrower (must have collateral).

tools.name: mantle_buildAaveRepay
tools.description:
Build an unsigned Aave V3 repay transaction. Use amount='max' to repay the full debt. Remember to approve the asset for the Pool first.

Examples:
- Repay 50 USDC: asset='USDC', amount='50', on_behalf_of='0x...'
- Repay full WMNT debt: asset='WMNT', amount='max', on_behalf_of='0x...'

asset.description: Token symbol or address to repay.

amount.description: Decimal amount to repay, or 'max' for full debt.

on_behalf_of.description: Address of the borrower whose debt to repay.

tools.name: mantle_buildAaveWithdraw
tools.description:
Build an unsigned Aave V3 withdraw transaction. Use amount='max' to withdraw entire balance. May lower health factor.

Examples:
- Withdraw 50 USDC: asset='USDC', amount='50', to='0x...'
- Withdraw all WMNT: asset='WMNT', amount='max', to='0x...'

asset.description: Token symbol or address to withdraw.

amount.description: Decimal amount to withdraw, or 'max' for full balance.

to.description: Address to receive the withdrawn tokens.

tools.name: mantle_buildAaveSetCollateral
tools.description:
Build an unsigned Aave V3 transaction to enable or disable a supplied asset as collateral.

MSG.SENDER: This transaction operates on the SIGNING WALLET (msg.sender), not an arbitrary address. The user param is only used for preflight diagnostics.

DIAGNOSTICS: When user is provided, runs on-chain checks before building the tx:
- Verifies aToken balance > 0 (user has actually supplied)
- Checks reserve config (LTV > 0, active, not frozen)
- Reads user config bitmap to detect if collateral is already enabled/disabled
- Returns a diagnostics object with the findings

If getUserAccountData shows totalCollateralBase=0 after a successful supply, possible causes (checked in order):
1. Collateral flag not enabled → this tool fixes it
2. Reserve LTV=0 on-chain → tool will error with LTV_IS_ZERO
3. Oracle price=0 → collateral enabled but USD value is 0
4. Reserve not active → tool will error with RESERVE_NOT_ACTIVE

Examples:
- Enable WMNT as collateral: asset='WMNT', user='0x...' (user for diagnostics)
- Disable USDC as collateral: asset='USDC', user='0x...', use_as_collateral=false

asset.description: Token symbol or address to enable/disable as collateral.

user.description: Wallet address for preflight diagnostics (aToken balance, collateral status, reserve config). NOT encoded into the tx — the tx always operates on msg.sender.

use_as_collateral.description: true to enable as collateral (default), false to disable.

tools.name: mantle_getSwapPairs
tools.description:
List known trading pairs and their pool parameters for a DEX. Returns bin_step (Merchant Moe) or fee_tier (Agni/Fluxion) for each pair. Call this BEFORE mantle_buildSwap to get the correct pool parameters.

Examples:
- All Merchant Moe pairs: provider='merchant_moe'
- All Agni pairs: provider='agni'
- All pairs across all DEXes: (no provider)

provider.description: Filter by DEX: 'agni', 'fluxion', or 'merchant_moe'. Omit for all DEXes.

tools.name: mantle_buildCollectFees
tools.description:
Build an unsigned transaction to collect accrued fees from a V3 LP position (Agni or Fluxion). Collects the maximum available fees for both tokens.

WORKFLOW:
1. Call mantle_getV3Positions to find positions with tokens_owed0/tokens_owed1 > 0
2. Call mantle_buildCollectFees with the token_id
3. Sign and broadcast the unsigned_tx

Examples:
- Collect Agni fees: provider='agni', token_id='12345', recipient='0x...'
- Collect Fluxion fees: provider='fluxion', token_id='67890', recipient='0x...'

recipient.description: Address to receive the collected fees.

tools.name: mantle_querySubgraph
tools.description: Execute a GraphQL query against a Mantle indexer endpoint. Examples: query Agni pool snapshots from https://indexer.example.com/graphql for router 0x319B69888b0d11cEC22caA5034e25FfFBDc88421.

tools.name: mantle_queryIndexerSql
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL query against an indexer API. Examples: SELECT liquidity rows for USDC 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9 from https://indexer.example.com/sql.

tools.name: mantle_checkRpcHealth
tools.description: Check RPC endpoint health and chain-id consistency. Examples: mainnet https://rpc.mantle.xyz should match chain 5000 and support USDC workflows at 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9.

tools.name: mantle_probeEndpoint
tools.description: Probe a specific JSON-RPC endpoint with a minimal method call. Examples: eth_blockNumber against https://rpc.mantle.xyz for router checks near 0x319B69888b0d11cEC22caA5034e25FfFBDc88421.
